facts.fact: PeeringDB's record for Michcom-IX, an open-access carrier-neutral exchange in Freetown run by Michcom Limited, lists 5 peers (Afcom SL, AI Networks, Fiber One SL, Michcom, route servers), 6 connections and 60G total capacity, with points of presence at Zoodlabs CLS MMR in Freetown and Leonecom MMR in Jui; operator-maintained record last updated 2026-06-03.
